sections.title: Data controller
sections.content: The controller of your data is **{name}**. You can contact me at [{email}](mailto:{email}).

sections.title: What data I collect
sections.content: When you use the contact form I collect your **name**, **email address**, **subject** and **message**. The hosting provider also logs technical data, such as your IP address, to serve and protect the site. All fields are required, but using the form is voluntary. Only your email address needs to be real for me to reply.

sections.title: How I use it
sections.content: I use your data **only to reply to your message**. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) or my legitimate interest in answering your enquiry (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). I don't use it to send you marketing. The hosting's technical logs are processed based on my legitimate interest in keeping the site secure and running (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). I don't make automated decisions or build profiles with your data.

sections.title: Who else processes it
sections.content: The form is sent as an email through **Brevo** (Brevo SAS, France) and arrives in my email inbox. The site is hosted on **Netlify**. Brevo and Netlify act as data processors and only process the data to provide their service. I don't share your data with anyone else.

sections.title: International transfers
sections.content: Brevo hosts the data in the **European Union** (France and Belgium). Some of its providers and group companies in the United States and India may access it for content delivery, support or maintenance, relying on the **EU-US Data Privacy Framework** or the European Commission's **Standard Contractual Clauses**. Netlify is based in the **United States**, is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and also uses Standard Contractual Clauses where it doesn't apply.

sections.title: How long I keep it
sections.content: I keep your data for as long as needed to handle your enquiry and for **12 months** at most. After that I delete it from my inbox. Of the form data, Brevo only keeps your email address (as the reply-to address) and the subject in its send log for **1 month**.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.content: You can ask me to access, rectify or erase your data, object to or restrict its processing, or request its portability by writing to [{email}](mailto:{email}). If you think I haven't handled it properly, you can lodge a complaint with the [Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD)](https://www.aepd.es/en) or another EU supervisory authority.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.content: This site doesn't use analytics or tracking cookies. It only stores your preferences: a `lang` cookie with your chosen language (1 year) and, in the browser's local storage, the theme (`theme`) and the scroll position when switching languages (`scrollY`).

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.content: If I change this policy, I'll update the date shown at the top of the page.
